name: smwmusic-donkey-kong-country-the-golden-swing-bonus-room-blitz-remix
title: Donkey Kong Country - The Golden Swing ~ Bonus Room Blitz (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Bonus Room Blitz from Donkey Kong Country 1. Was humming the song out of nowhere and decided that I wanted to do a more relaxed take on the song similar to DKC Returns while also doing something as flashy as DKC3's Dixie Beat (SNES version). It's an overall fantastic, catchy, and iconic bonus theme from the series, even if it isn't my favorite in the SNES Trilogy.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.
